lines.ja: おお、ええやんけ。これから寒うなるからな、セーターは重宝すんで。
lines.en: Oh, looks great! It's gonna get cold soon, so a sweater will come in handy.

lines.ja: とってもお似合いですよ！
lines.en: It looks so good on you!
lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.ja: 首のとこ締め付けられてキモいにゃ。
lines.en: It's choking my neck, it feels gross nya.
lines.speaker: Yanineko

clips.title: Thought It Was a Rag
grammar: 〜しかない — only have / nothing but

lines.ja: ごめんなさい！ボロ布だと思って！
lines.en: I'm so sorry! I thought it was a rag!
lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.ja: ま、まあ似たようなもんやしな。
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: しゃあない、ヤニねこ何か服買うて帰ろ。
lines.en: Oh well, Yanineko, let's buy some clothes and head home.

lines.en: What did you even come here for?!
lines.speaker: Friend

clips.title: A Serious Clumsy Mistake
grammar: 〜じゃなくて — not A, but B

lines.ja: あぁ…さっき燃やしちゃったかも…
lines.en: Ah... I might have burned them earlier...
lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.en: Why on earth would you do that?!
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: ゴミだと思って…あわわわ…
lines.en: I thought they were garbage... ah wah wah...
lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.ja: 臭かったんで、ゴミ箱じゃなくてガソリンで完全に炭にしてしまいました…
lines.en: They smelled bad, so instead of the trash bin, I used gasoline to burn them completely to ashes...
lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.en: Are you out of your mind?!
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: お前、人の服にガソリンで火付ける行為をドジって認識しとんのか！
lines.en: You think torching someone's clothes with gasoline counts as being clumsy?!
lines.speaker: Friend
